edges.reason: Qur'an explicitly identifies Injil as given to Isa; the candidate mapping to four canonical Gospels is a separate claim requiring evidence.
Qur'an's statement that Allah sent down the Torah does not by itself identify every modern Pentateuchal text as identical to that revelation.
Both are named revelations in the Quran, but they have different recipients and should not be collapsed into one text tradition.
Quranic revelation claims are distinct source records and should not be merged into later textual identification claims.
